meanings.note: Used among friends and peers by men; switch to 私 or 僕 in formal settings.

meanings.en: as for; topic or contrast marker
meanings.note: Written は but pronounced wa when marking the topic or contrasting one item with another.
Blunt or rowdy second-person pronoun used with subordinates, rivals, or close crew.

examples.trans: I leave it to you guys.

meanings.note: Written を and pronounced o; marks what an action directly acts upon.
All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.
Limits the preceding noun or phrase to that item alone.

examples.text: これだけお願いします。

meanings.note: Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.

meanings.en: go home; leave and go back
meanings.note: Repeated past form 帰った、帰った! is an idiomatic shooing command ('off you go, go on home!').

meanings.en: location of action; means; scope total
meanings.note: Marks where an action happens, the unit/scope of a rate or total (十日で, 全部で), or the cause/occasion.

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

meanings.note: Transitive godan verb.

examples.text: 週末は家でゆっくり過ごしました。
examples.trans: I spent the weekend relaxing at home.

examples.text: 毎日忙しい日々を過ごしています。
examples.trans: I spend busy days every day.

meanings.note: Calls someone's attention ('look here!') or asks for a brief pause (ちょっと待って).

examples.text: ちょっと待ってください。
ちょっと見てください。

meanings.note: て-form 待って + ください is 'please wait'; causative お待たせして means 'having kept you waiting'.
Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.

meanings.en: do a favor for the speaker
meanings.note: After a te-form (会ってくれる？), warmly asks 'will you do that for us?'

examples.trans: Will you come again for me?

examples.text: 母が料理を作ってくれました。
examples.trans: My mother cooked food for me.

meanings.note: Casual, blunt contraction of あなた used between intimates or in heated speech.
Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).

meanings.en: do for an inferior (tough-guy てやる)
meanings.note: After て-form (勘弁してやる), expresses granting a favor from a position of authority.

examples.trans: I will give you a hand (casual masculine).

examples.text: お前ら、観光じゃないんだからしっかりしろよ。
examples.trans: Hey, this isn't sightseeing, so pull yourselves together.

examples.text: 彼女は来るんだろうな？
ちゃんとキャストはそろってるんだろうな？
examples.trans: You've got the whole cast properly lined up, right?

meanings.note: 分かってる asks or states ongoing understanding; plain past 分かった means 'got it! / I understand'.

examples.text: 日本語が少し分かります。

examples.trans: Got it, I will come right away.

meanings.note: Follows a clause to give a reason or reassuring explanation.

examples.trans: Because it is close, I walk.

meanings.note: Negates verbs or forms じゃない ('is not') in questions like いいんじゃないか.
Adverb emphasizing that there is nothing more.

examples.text: ただ本当のことを言っただけです。
ただ静かに待っていた。

meanings.note: In もういい, means 'already enough' or 'ready now'.
Noun derived from 終わる (to end).

examples.text: これで今日の授業は終わりです。
examples.trans: With this, today's class is over.

meanings.note: Adverb.

examples.text: まだ終わっていません。

meanings.note: Godan verb.

examples.text: 会議は何時に終わりますか。
examples.trans: What time does the meeting end?

meanings.en: from now on; in the future; now
meanings.note: Time expression referring to the immediate or upcoming future.

examples.text: これから家へ帰ります。

examples.trans: The real test starts from here.

meanings.note: Marks the subject of existence, emergence, or questions (どれが), and at the end of a polite clause softens a request (のですが).

examples.text: お願いがあるのですが。
examples.trans: I have a favor to ask.

examples.text: これからガンガン稼いで、一緒にいい景色見るんだろうがよ！
examples.trans: We were going to earn big and see the view from the top together!

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Potential stem + そう (稼げそう) means 'looks like one can earn well'.

examples.text: しっかりお金を稼ぎます。
今月はよく稼げました。
examples.trans: I was able to earn well this month.

meanings.note: Irregular i-adjective whose past/conditional stems use よ- (よかったら).

examples.text: よかったら来てください。
これからガンガン稼いで、一緒にいい景色見るんだろうがよ！
examples.trans: We were going to earn big and see the view from the top together!

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Ichidan verb: blunt imperative 見ろ ('look!') is rough command speech.

examples.trans: You are going to regret this.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.
